notes.title: Working on LOD
notes.content:
Lower end devices (with e.g. integrated GPUs, older systems) and especially the VR mode need extra optimization to run on high frame-rate. I'm working on a LOD system to support great view distances and keep framerate high. Here are some comparisons. Some quick performance tests yield around 50% better performance but I think that's not all...

notes.title: Current Status
notes.content:
Wow... long time since I created this entry here on Steam. I decided against finalizing the Steam version based on the old Discovery engine. Instead I began with a complete rewrite with modern engine/tech and especially clean code.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39649384/47b40cbc8335f2466dcc4154540204f09f21f92b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39649384/47b40cbc8335f2466dcc4154540204f09f21f92b.gif[/img][/url]

The new version has been released on April, the 1st as Early Access on the Meta Quest platform and is available on Android as Non-VR too.

The main focus on this reelase was the handtracking, mixed-reality and tabletop mode. All of these will also be available in the Steam version (mixed-reality not safe). This is how it looks

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39649384/1f4bdc959e10f72ba29c1b0a437909ee80214179.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39649384/1f4bdc959e10f72ba29c1b0a437909ee80214179.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39649384/e0936c925f55210583d20f06e5750fd4b6602959.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39649384/e0936c925f55210583d20f06e5750fd4b6602959.gif[/img][/url]

I have made massive progress in the last few weeks but there are some key features missing that need to be implemented before I can release it as a proper version here on Steam.

I'm closing with a small comparision between old and new engine. Stay tuned and spread the word!
